entry.title: New: Resolution 242 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AND APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM THE DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITING SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT

Transfers $5,000 from the Liquor Control/Public Programs account to the Sundry Refund account to return funds to the General Fund.
